name: Acid fog
description: Acid fog creates a thick, clinging, greenish cloud. Creatures entering the cloud take 4[[d6]] [[acid damage]]. Creatures inside the cloud must make a fortitude [[saving throw|save]] or have their movement reduced by 50%. Every round a creature spends in the cloud, it suffers 2d6 acid damage.

name: Acid splash
description:
The caster fires a small orb of acid at the target for 1d3
points of [[acid damage]].

name: Aid
description: The target gains a +1 bonus to [[attack roll]]s, a +1 bonus on [[saving throw]]s versus [[frightened|fear]], and a 1d8 bonus to maximum [[hit point]]s.

name: Amplify
description: The caster or a target gains a +20 bonus to [[listen]] checks.

name: Animate dead
description: Animate dead [[summon]]s forth an [[undead]] minion. The type of undead summoned is dependent upon the caster level.

name: Aura of glory
description:
The caster channels divine power to gain a +4 [[charisma]]
bonus. All allies near the caster gain a +5 bonus to their [[saving throw]]s
versus [[fear]].

name: Aura of glory (cursed)
description:
The caster channels divine power to gain a +2 [[charisma]]
bonus. All allies near the caster gain a +6 bonus to their [[saving throw]]s
versus [[fear]].

name: Aura of vitality
description: All allies within the [[area of effect]] receive a +4 bonus to [[constitution]], [[dexterity]], and [[strength]].

name: Aura versus alignment
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses to be protected from either [[good]] or [[evil]]. He receives a +4 [[deflection bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]], [[immunity]] to [[mind-affecting]] [[spell]]s and spell-like abilities used by [[creature]]s of the chosen [[alignment]], and [[spell resistance]] 25 against spells cast <strike>by creatures of the chosen alignment</strike>. Creatures <strike>of the chosen alignment</strike> also take 6 + 1d8 damage each time they successfully strike the cleric.

name: Awaken
description:
The target animal companion gains +4 [[constitution]], +1d10
[[wisdom]], +4 [[strength]], and +2 to [[attack roll]]s for as long as it remains at the druid's side.

name: Balagarn's iron horn
description: The caster creates a deep, resonant vibration that shakes all creatures in the area of effect from their feet if they fail a [[strength]] check (as if the caster had a strength of 20). Every creature that falls will be [[prone|knocked down]] for one [[round]].

name: Ball lightning
description: You create a ball of lightning that strikes your target. The [[electrical damage]] of the ball is 1[[d6]] per [[caster level|level]] to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Bane
description: Bane fills the caster's enemies with fear and doubt. They suffer a -1 penalty on their [[attack roll]]s and a -1 penalty on [[saving throw]]s against [[fear]].

name: Banishment
description: The caster is able to cause all [[summon]]ed creatures, [[familiar]]s, [[animal companion]]s, and [[outsider]]s in the [[area of effect]] to be destroyed. A number of creatures equal to twice the caster's level in [[hit dice|HD]] can be banished.

name: Barkskin
description:
Barkskin hardens the target creature's skin, granting a
[[natural armor bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]] based on the caster's level:

name: Battletide
description:
You create an aura that steals energy from your enemies.
Your enemies suffer a -2 circumstance penalty on [[saving throw]]s, [[attack roll]]s, and damage rolls, once entering the aura. On casting, you gain a +2
circumstance bonus to your saves, attack rolls, and damage rolls.

name: Bestow curse
description: Lowers all of the target creature's [[ability]] scores by 2.

name: Bigby's clenched fist
description: A giant hand appears and attacks the target, once each round for the duration of the spell. Each hit causes 1d8+11 points of [[bludgeoning damage]] to the target and if they fail their [[saving throw]] they are [[stunned]] for that round as well.

name: Bigby's crushing hand
description:
A giant hand appears and attacks the target. If it hits and
succeeds in a grapple check, the target is held fast for the duration of the
spell and suffers 2[[d6]]+12 points of [[bludgeoning damage]] each round.

name: Bigby's forceful hand
description: A giant hand appears and attempts to bull rush one target. The hand gains a +14 bonus on the [[strength]] check. A target that is bull rushed is knocked down and is [[dazed]] for the duration of the spell.

name: Bigby's grasping hand
description: A giant hand appears and attacks the target. If the hand hits and succeeds in a grapple check, the opponent will be held for the duration of the [[spell]].

name: Bigby's interposing hand
description:
A giant hand appears over the target, making it difficult for
him to attack. He receives a -10 penalty to all [[attack roll]]s for the duration of the spell.

name: Black blade of disaster
description: The caster creates [[black blade of disaster (summon)|a black blade-shaped planar rift]], resembling a greatsword which fights at her side. The blade cannot be harmed by physical attacks, but it can be affected by [[dispel magic]] or similar effects. <strike>For the purpose of bypassing damage reduction, the sword has an enhancement bonus equal to your intelligence bonus or your charisma bonus (for wizards and sorcerers respectively) to a maximum of +20</strike>. The spell requires the caster to concentrate on it — casting spells or performing any other action than walking or talking may result in a concentration failure and end the spell.

name: Blackstaff
area: creature holding a [[quarterstaff]] or a quarterstaff item
description:
Casting this spell on a quarterstaff will do the following:
* Gives it a +4 [[enhancement bonus]].
* On striking a creature, ''[[dispel magic]]'' is cast on the target.
The spell will not work on any other weapon than a quarterstaff.

name: Blade barrier
description: ''Blade barrier'' brings into being a 30-foot long and 3-foot wide wall of stabbing blades. All those passing through the wall take 1[[d6]] points of [[slashing damage]] per caster level.

name: Blade thirst
description: You grant a [[slashing damage|slashing]] weapon a +3 [[enhancement bonus]]. If targeted on a creature, the spell will enchant the weapon in the primary hand of the target.

name: Bless
description: All allies within the [[area of effect]] gain a +1 bonus to [[attack roll]]s, along with a +1 bonus on [[will]] saves against [[frightened|fear]].

name: Bless weapon
description: You empower the touched [[melee weapon]] with a +1 [[enhancement bonus]], and a 2d6 [[divine damage]] bonus vs. [[undead]]. You can also target another creature to enchant its worn melee weapon.

name: Blindness/deafness
description: The target creature is struck [[blind]] and [[deaf]].

name: Blood frenzy
description: The caster enters a rage similar to that of a [[barbarian]]. The caster gains a +2 bonus to [[constitution]] and [[strength]] and a +1 bonus to [[will]] saves, while suffering a -1 penalty to [[armor class]].

name: Bombardment
description: Rocks fall from the sky, causing 1d8 points of [[bludgeoning damage]] per caster level (to a maximum of 10d8) to all enemies in the area.

name: Bull's strength
description: The target creature's [[strength]] is increased by 1[[d4]] + 1.

name: Burning hands
description:
A cone of fire shoots forth from the caster's hands, burning
all those within its [[area of effect]] for 1[[d4]] [[fire damage]] per caster level, up to a maximum of 5d4.

name: Call lightning
description:
All enemies within the [[area of effect]] take 1[[d6]] points of
[[electrical damage]] per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6.

name: Camouflage
description: The caster's coloring changes to match the surroundings, gaining a +10 competence bonus to any [[hide]] checks.

name: Cat's grace
description: The target creature's [[dexterity]] is increased by 1[[d4]] + 1.

name: Chain lightning
description: A bolt of electricity arcs through the caster's enemies for 1[[d6]] points of [[electrical damage]] per caster level, up to a max of 20d6 points of damage to the initial target and half that amount to all other targets.

name: Charm monster
description: In the eyes of the target creature, the personal [[reputation]] of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Charm person
description: In the eyes of the target [[humanoid]], the personal [[reputation]] of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Charm person or animal
description: In the eyes of the target [[animal]] or [[humanoid]], the personal [[reputation]] of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Circle of death
description: A wave of negative energy bursts from the target location. A number of enemy creatures equal to 1[[d4]] per caster level must make a [[fortitude]] save or die, beginning with those creatures with the lowest [[hit dice]]. Creatures with 9 or more hit dice are unaffected.

name: Circle of doom
description: All enemies within the area of effect are struck with negative energy that causes 1[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage]], +1 point per caster level. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], healing them instead of harming them.

name: Clairaudience/clairvoyance
description: For the duration of the spell, the target creature gains a +10 bonus to all [[listen]] and [[spot]] checks.

name: Clarity
description: This spell removes the [[effect]]s of [[dazed|daze]], [[sleep]], [[confused|confusion]], [[stunned|stun]], and [[charmed|charm]], and protects against all [[mind-affecting]] effects until it expires. For every effect removed by the spell, the target creature sustains 1 point of [[negative energy damage]].

name: Cloud of bewilderment
description: The caster blows forth a cloud of noxious air. Enemies in the area of effect are [[stunned]] and [[blind]]ed for 1[[d6]] rounds.

name: Cloudkill
description: A billowing cloud of noxious vapors settles over the area. Its effects vary according to the [[hit dice]] of the affected creatures:

name: Color spray
description: '''Color spray''' sends forth a dazzling array of lights to confound all creatures within the area of effect. Its effects vary according to the [[hit dice]] of the affected creatures:

name: Combust
description: This spell makes a creature burst into flame. The initial eruption of flame causes 2[[d6]] [[fire damage]] +1 point per caster level (maximum +10) with no [[saving throw]]. Further, the creature must make a reflex save or catch fire taking a further 1d6 points of damage. This will continue until the reflex save is made.

name: Cone of cold
description: A cone of frost and snow shoots forth from the caster's hands, doing 1[[d6]] points of [[cold damage]] per caster level to all those within the [[area of effect]], to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Confusion
description: Affected creatures either wander randomly, attack a random target, or simply stand still.

name: Contagion
description: The target creature is struck down with one of the following debilitating diseases, randomly chosen: [[blinding sickness]], [[cackle fever]], [[mindfire]], [[red ache]], [[shakes]], or [[slimy doom]].

name: Continual flame
description: This creates a magical flame that burns as bright as a [[torch]] <s>until dispelled</s>. It can be cast on any item that can be equipped to create a permanent source of light.

name: Control undead
description: A single [[undead]] creature with up to 2 [[hit dice]] per caster level [[dominated|falls under the caster's control]] unless it makes a successful will save.

name: Create greater undead
description: The caster [[summon|brings]] a powerful [[undead]] creature into being. The type of undead is based upon the caster's level:

name: Create shadowfiend
description: Summons a shadow, however, there is a 20% chance of the shadow being hostile.

name: Create undead
description: The caster [[summon|brings]] an [[undead]] creature into being. The type of undead is based upon the caster's level.

name: Creeping doom
description: The caster summons a mass of biting and stinging insects which causes 1[[d6]] points of [[piercing damage]]. For every subsequent round <s>that a creature remains within the area of effect</s>, the damage inflicted is increased by <s>an increment of</s> 1d6 (i.e. 1d6 for the first round, 2d6 for the second, <s>4d6</s> ''3d6'' for the third, <s>7d6</s> ''4d6'' for the fourth, and so on). The spell deals damage until its duration expires or it deals 1,000 points of damage.

name: Crumble
description: This spell inflicts 1[[d6]] points of [[sonic damage]] per caster level to a selected construct (to a maximum of 15d6). This spell does not affect living creatures.

name: Cure critical wounds
description: The target creature is healed of 4[[d8]] points of damage, + 1 point per caster level to a maximum of +20. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of [[positive energy damage|damage]] equal to what the spell normally heals. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure critical wounds (others)
description: The target creature is healed of 4[[d8]] points of damage, + 1 point per caster level to a maximum of +20. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of positive energy damage equal to what the spell normally heals. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure light wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 1[[d8]] points of damage, +1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +5). Healing spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure minor wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 4 points of damage. Healing spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure moderate wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 2[[d8]] points of damage, +1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +10). Healing spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure serious wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 3[[d8]] points of damage, +1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +15). Healing spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them. A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Darkfire
description: This spell allows the caster to immolate a non-magical [[weapon]]. The weapon will do 1[[d6]] points of damage, +1 per two caster levels (maximum of +10) of [[fire damage]]. The caster can either target a specific melee weapon in his inventory or a creature to enchant the weapon the creature is wielding.

name: Darkness (spell)
description: All creatures within the [[area of effect]] are shrouded in a haze of [[darkness]] which can only be pierced using [[ultravision]].

name: Daze
description: If the target humanoid creature has 5 [[hit dice]] or less, they are [[dazed]] for 2 rounds.

name: Deafening clang
description: You empower a weapon with a +1 [[attack bonus (item property)|attack bonus]] and a +3 [[sonic damage]] bonus. Also, the weapon gains the ability to [[deaf]]en the creature that is struck like a [[thunderstone]]. The attack bonus will not [[stack]] with existing [[enhancement bonus]] or [[holy avenger]] properties.

name: Death armor
description: A magical [[aura]] surrounds the caster — injuring [[creature]]s that touch it. Any creature striking the caster takes 1[[d4]] points of [[magical damage]] +1 point per 2 [[caster level]]s (maximum +5).

name: Death ward
description: The target creature becomes immune to any [[death magic|death spells]], spell-like abilities, and effects.

name: Delayed blast fireball
description: The caster creates a small, magical zone that can detect the passage of enemy creatures. When the field is activated, it explodes, doing 1[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]] per caster level to all within the [[area of effect]], to a maximum of 20d6.

name: Destruction
description: The target creature must make a fortitude save or die. A successful save still results in the target taking 10d6 points of [[divine damage]].

name: Dirge
description: The caster's song draws the energies of death and destruction. Any enemies in the area of effect suffer 2 points of [[strength]] and [[dexterity]] [[ability damage|ability score damage]] each round. If the enemy leaves the area of effect, their strength and dexterity are restored.

name: Dismissal
description: All [[summon]]ed creatures, [[animal companion]]s, and [[familiar]]s belonging to enemy spellcasters are unsummoned within the [[area of effect]].

name: Dispel magic
description:
This spell attempts to strip all [[magical effect]]s from a single
target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the
most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect, the
caster makes a [[dispel]] check of 1[[d20]] +1 per [[caster level]] (to a maximum of
+10) against a [[difficulty class|DC]] of 11 + the spell effect's caster level.

name: Displacement
description: The target gains 50% [[concealment]], displacing the caster's image several feet to the side, similar to the abilities of a displacer beast.

name: Divine favor
description:
The caster gains a +1 bonus to [[attack bonus|attack]] and weapon damage
rolls for every three [[caster level]]s (at least +1, to a maximum of +5).

name: Divine power
description: The caster gains the following bonuses: 1 extra [[hit point]] per caster level, [[strength]] is raised to 18 (if their strength is already 18 or higher, it is not raised further), and [[base attack bonus]] improves to that of a [[fighter]] of the same level.

name: Dominate animal
description: The target [[animal]] temporarily becomes a [[dominated|faithful and loyal]] [[associate|servant]] of the caster.

name: Dominate monster
description: The target monster temporarily becomes a [[dominated|faithful and loyal]] [[associate|servant]] of the caster.

name: Dominate person
description: The target person temporarily becomes a [[dominated|faithful and loyal]] [[associate|servant]] of the caster.

name: Doom
description: The target creature receives a -2 modifier to all [[attack roll]]s, [[magical damage]], [[saving throw]]s, <strike>ability checks</strike> and [[skill check]]s.

name: Dragon knight
description:
The caster summons [[red dragon (summon)|a powerful adult red dragon]] to the
targeted location to fight on his side.

name: Drown
description: The caster creates water in the lungs of a target creature. Any drowned creature takes 90% of its current [[hit point]]s as [[bludgeoning damage]]. Golems and other nonliving creatures cannot be drowned.

name: Eagle's splendor
description: The target [[creature]]'s [[charisma]] is increased by 1[[d4]]+1.

name: Earthquake
description: The caster causes a massive earthquake around himself, causing 1[[d6]] points of [[bludgeoning damage|damage]] per [[caster level]] (to a maximum of 10d6) to all creatures in the [[area of effect]]. The caster is not affected by the earthquake.

name: Electric jolt
description: The caster does 1[[d3]] points of [[electrical damage]] to a target.

name: Elemental shield
description: The caster is surrounded by a ring of fire that damages all opponents who make a successful melee attack on the caster. The [[fire damage|damage]] inflicted is 1[[d6]], +1 point per caster level. The caster also gains 50% [[immunity]] to [[cold damage|cold]] and fire.

name: Elemental swarm
description: The caster summons a 21 [[hit die]] [[greater air elemental]] to act as a loyal servant until it dies or until the spell expires. If the air elemental dies before the spell ends, a 21 hit die [[greater water elemental]] is automatically summoned to replace it. This process continues with a [[greater earth elemental]] and [[greater fire elemental]] until the spell expires. After the fire elemental, no more are summoned.

name: Endurance
description: The target [[creature]]'s [[constitution]] is increased by 1[[d4]]+1.

name: Endure elements
description: The target creature gains [[damage resistance]] 10/- against all elemental [[damage type|forms of damage]]. The spell ends after absorbing 20 points of damage from any single elemental type.

name: Energy buffer
description: The caster gains [[damage resistance]] 40/- against all elemental [[damage type|forms of damage]]. The spell ends after absorbing 60 points of damage from any single elemental type.

name: Energy drain
description: The target creature permanently [[level drain|loses]] 2[[d4]] character levels.

name: Enervation
description: The target creature temporarily [[level drain|loses]] 1[[d4]] character levels.

name: Entangle (spell)
description: Ingame description: A mass of clinging vegetation wraps around all creatures in the [[area of effect]]. Those affected are [[entangle|immobilized]], though still able to fight and cast spells. Victims who make a reflex save still have their movement reduced by half.

name: Entropic shield
description: A magical field appears around the caster, causing any nearby enemies a 20% chance to miss on ranged attacks.

name: Epic mage armor
description: The caster gets a +20 [[armor class]] bonus.

name: Epic warding
description: This spell conjures a powerful magical ward around the caster protecting against all [[physical damage]]. It grants [[damage reduction]] 50/+20 and absorbs 50 points of damage per caster level before collapsing.

name: Ethereal visage
description: The caster is surrounded by a ghostly nimbus of light that grants [[damage reduction]] 20/+3, [[spell immunity|prevents]] all spells of level 2 or lower from affecting the caster and provides a 25% [[concealment]] bonus.

name: Evard's black tentacles
description:
[[Image:Evards_tentacles.jpg|right|thumb|160px|Evard's Black Tentacles spell visual effect.]]
A field of thick, 10 foot long rubbery tentacles rises from the ground.  Each is capable of grappling a target doing 1[[d6]]+4 points [[bludgeoning damage]]. If successful, the target must then make a fortitude [[saving throw]] or become [[paralyze]]d by the grappling tentacle. The tentacles are randomly spread out over the [[area of effect]] allowing no more than half of the tentacles to reach a single target in any given round. The inability of the tentacles to target [[small stature|small creature]]s makes all small creatures completely immune to the spell's effects.

name: Evil blight
description: All enemies within the [[area of effect]] have a [[curse]] placed on them, lowering all of their [[ability|stat]]s by 3.

name: Expeditious retreat
description: The caster becomes 150% [[movement speed increase|faster]] than their normal [[movement rate]], allowing them to flee from dangerous encounters. This spell has no effect if the caster is already hasted.

name: Fear (spell)
description: Affected creatures are consumed with mind-numbing [[frightened|fear]] that overrides all other actions. The affected creatures run away from all those they do not consider allies.

name: Feeblemind
description: <strike>With a successful ranged touch attack</strike>, the caster does 1[[d4]] points of [[intelligence]] damage to the creature for every 4 [[caster level]]s.

name: Find traps
description: All [[trap]]s within the [[area of effect]] become known to the caster of this spell and are disarmed.

name: Finger of death
description: The target creature must make a fortitude save or die. If they succeed, they still take 3[[d6]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], +1 point per caster level.

name: Fire storm
description: All enemies within this spell's area of effect are inundated with a rain of fire and take 1[[d6]] points of damage per caster level <strike>(to a maximum of 20d6)</strike>. Half of the damage is [[divine damage|divine]] and the other half is [[fire damage|fire-based]].

name: Fireball
description: The caster unleashes a fiery projectile that explodes upon all within the area of effect for 1[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]] per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6.

name: Firebrand
description: Masses of flame (one per caster level) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile creature in the area of effect. If there are more creatures than balls of flame, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more balls of flame than creatures, the excess balls of flame disappear. Each ball of flame explodes for 1[[d6]] points of [[fire damage|damage]] per caster level (max 15d6).

name: Flame arrow
description: The caster launches 1 conjured fiery arrow at the target creature for every 4 [[caster level]]s. Each arrow does 4[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]].

name: Flame lash
description: The druid is able to flay an enemy with flaming brands that do 2[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]], + 1d6 per 3 caster levels above level 3.

name: Flame strike
description: A pillar of flame engulfs all within the area of effect, inflicting 1[[d6]] points of damage per caster level (to a maximum of 15d6). Half of the damage caused by the spell is [[divine damage|divine]] and the other half is [[fire damage|fire-based]]. Enemies are struck by both damage types, while allies are struck only by the fire damage.

name: Flame weapon
description: Sets a [[melee weapon]] aflame, granting 1[[d4]] points of [[fire damage]] +1 per caster level to a maximum of +10. You can target a specific weapon or a creature with this spell.

name: Flare
description: A burst of hot light is fired from the caster to one target, making it suffer a -1 penalty to [[attack roll]]s.

name: Flesh to stone
description: The subject and all possessions it carries [[petrified|turns into a mindless, inert statue]]. Only a ''[[stone to flesh]]'' spell can restore the subject to normal.

name: Fox's cunning
description: The target creature's [[intelligence]] is increased by 1[[d4]]+1.

name: Freedom of movement
description:
The target creature becomes immune to [[paralysis]], [[slow]],
and [[entangle]]ment spells and effects.

name: Gate
description: This powerful [[summon]]ing spell opens a portal to another plane, calling forth a balor. If the caster is protected by the effects of [[protection from evil]], [[magic circle against evil]], or [[aura versus evil]], the [[balor (summon)|balor]] becomes their faithful and loyal servant. If the caster is not so protected, the [[balor]] attempts to destroy them.

name: Gedlee's electric loop
description: You create a small stroke of lightning that cycles through all creatures in the [[area of effect]]. The spell deals 1[[d6]] points of [[electrical damage|damage]] per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d6). Those who fail their reflex saves must succeed at a [[will]] save or be [[stunned]] for 1 [[round]].

name: Ghostly visage
description: The caster is surrounded by a ghostly nimbus of light that grants [[damage reduction]] 5/+1, [[spell immunity|prevents]] all spells of level 1 or lower from affecting the caster, and grants 10% [[concealment]].

name: Ghoul touch
description: The caster's hand glows with an unearthly radiance. The target creature must make a fortitude save or become [[paralyze]]d. Creatures paralyzed by this spell emit a noxious cloud that applies a -2 penalty to [[skill]]s, [[saving throw]]s, <s>[[attack roll]]s,</s> and damage rolls to all creatures within 5 feet.

name: Globe of invulnerability
description: A shimmering field of energy prevents all spells of level 4 or lower from affecting the caster.

name: Glyph of warding
description: The caster creates a small, magical zone that can detect the passage of enemy creatures. When the field is activated, it explodes, doing 1[[d8]] points of [[sonic damage]] per two caster levels to all creatures within the [[area of effect]] (to a maximum of 5d8). After being triggered, the glyph dissipates.

name: Grease
description: A churning field of oil and grease fills the target area, causing all within to either [[prone|fall down]] or move at a [[movement speed decrease|reduced speed]].

name: Great thunderclap
description: You create a loud noise equivalent to a peal of thunder and its accompanying shock wave. The spell has three effects. First, all creatures in the area must make [[will]] saves to avoid being [[stunned]] for 1 round. Second, the creatures must make [[fortitude]] saves or be [[deaf]]ened for 1 minute. Third, they must make [[reflex]] saves or fall [[prone]].

name: Greater bull's strength
description: The target creature's [[strength]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater cat's grace
description: The target creature's [[dexterity]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater dispelling
description: ''Greater dispelling'' attempts to strip all [[magical effect]]s from a single target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect, the caster makes a [[dispel]] check of 1[[d20]] + 1 per [[caster level]] (to a maximum of +15) against a [[difficulty class|DC]] of 11 + the spell effect's caster level.

name: Greater eagle's splendor
description: The target creature's [[charisma]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater endurance
description: The target creature's [[constitution]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater fox's cunning
description: The target creature's [[intelligence]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater magic fang
description: This spell strengthens the caster's [[animal companion]], giving it +1 [[attack bonus|to hit]] and +1 to damage for every three levels of the caster (maximum of +5). It also grants the creature [[damage reduction]] and [[enhancement bonus]] equal to the hit/damage bonus given.

name: Greater magic weapon
description: You empower the touched weapon with a +1 [[enhancement bonus]] per 3 [[caster level]]s (maximum of +5). You can either directly target the weapon you want to cast this spell on, or you can target a creature, affecting the creature's main hand weapon.

name: Greater owl's wisdom
description: The target creature's [[wisdom]] is increased by 2[[d4]] + 1.

name: Greater planar binding
description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single [[outsider]], or summoning a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are [[paralyze]]d for 1 round per 2 caster levels. The type of [[summon]]ed ally is based on the caster's [[alignment]]:

name: Greater restoration
description: ''Greater restoration'' removes most temporary and all permanent negative [[effect]]s from the target character, including [[level drain]]. It does not remove <s>negative mental effects or</s> the effects of [[movement speed decrease|reduced movement speed]]. It also heals the target creature to full [[hit point]]s.

name: Greater ruin
description: The caster deals 35[[d6]] [[positive energy damage]] to a single target.

name: Greater sanctuary
description: The caster becomes [[ethereal]]. No other creature can detect the caster. Attacking or performing a hostile action will make the etherealness vanish.

name: Greater shadow conjuration
description:
Allows the caster to conjure a shadow variant of one of the
following spells: [[summon shadow (shadow conjuration)|summon shadow]], [[Melf's acid arrow]], [[ghostly visage]], [[web]], or [[minor globe of invulnerability]].

name: Greater spell breach
description: This spell strips an enemy mage of up to four magical defenses, including [[spell mantle]], [[minor globe of invulnerability]], [[globe of invulnerability]], [[stoneskin]], [[greater stoneskin]], [[premonition]], [[protection from elements]], [[ghostly visage]] and [[ethereal visage]], [[mage armor]], [[shadow shield]], and [[elemental shield]]. This spell will also lower the target creature's [[spell resistance|SR]] rating by 5 for ten [[round]]s.

name: Greater spell mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that [[spell level absorption|absorbs]] all incoming spells. It can absorb up to 1[[d12]]+10 levels of spells before collapsing.

name: Greater stoneskin
description: Grants the caster a [[damage reduction]] of 20/+5. The spell absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level, to a maximum of 150, before fading.

name: Gust of wind
description: This spell creates a blast of air that [[prone|knocks down]] any creatures failing their [[saving throw]]s. It is also powerful enough to disperse any cloudlike [[area of effect]] spells (such as [[cloudkill]]) that are in the path of the wind gust.

name: Hammer of the gods
description: The caster smites a group of enemies with divine light for 1[[d8]] points of [[divine damage|damage]] for every two caster levels, to a maximum of 5d8. Enemies that make a will [[save]] take half damage and avoid being [[dazed]] for 1 to 6 [[round]]s.

name: Harm
description: If the caster makes a successful melee [[touch attack]], ''harm'' uses [[negative energy damage|negative energy]] to reduce the target creature to 1[[d4]] [[hit point]]s. This spell has a reverse effect on [[undead]], healing the targeted undead to full health instead of harming it.

name: Haste-slow
description: The target creature is either [[haste]]d (67% of the time) or [[slow]]ed (the remaining 33% of the time).

name: Haste (spell)
description: The target of this spell is [[haste]]d, gaining +4 bonus to dodge [[armor class]], 1 extra action per round (allowing an [[extra attack|additional attack]] or spell to be cast), and has their [[movement speed|movement]] increased by 50%.

name: Heal (spell)
description: The target of ''heal'' is restored to full [[hit point]]s. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them (undead are reduced to 1[[d4]] hit points with this spell). A successful [[touch attack]] must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Healing circle
description: All friendly creatures within the area of effect are healed for 1[[d8]] [[hit point]]s, +1 points per caster level up to a maximum of +20. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them.

name: Healing sting
description: You inflict 1[[d6]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], +1 per caster level, to the living creature touched and gain an equal amount of [[hit point]]s. You may not gain more hit points than your maximum with the ''healing sting''.

name: Hellball
description: The caster creates a ball of energy that does 10[[d6]] points of [[acid damage|acid]], [[fire damage|fire]], [[electrical damage|electrical]] and [[sonic damage]] to all targets in its blast radius.

name: Hold animal
description: The target [[animal]] is [[paralyze]]d for the duration of the spell.

name: Hold monster
description: The target monster is [[paralyze]]d for the duration of the spell.

name: Hold person
description: The target [[humanoid]] is [[paralyze]]d for the duration of the spell.

name: Holy sword
description: This spell transforms the caster's melee weapon into a powerful [[holy avenger]], a specially blessed weapon that, when wielded by paladin, acts like a +5 holy weapon that [[dispel]]s magic [[on-hit]], delivers an additional +1[[d6]] [[divine damage]] against [[evil]] aligned creatures and grants the wielder a [[spell resistance]] of 16.

name: Horizikaul's boom
description: You blast the target with loud and high-pitched sounds. The target takes 1[[d4]] points of [[sonic damage]] per two [[caster level]]s (maximum 5d4) and must make a will [[save]] or be [[deaf]]ened for 1d4 [[round]]s.

name: Horrid wilting
description: All creatures within the area of effect take 1[[d8]] points of [[magical damage|withering energy damage]] per [[caster level]], to a maximum of 25d8.

name: Ice dagger
description: You create a piece of ice that flies toward the target and deals 1[[d4]] points of [[cold damage]] per level (maximum of 5d4).

name: Ice storm
description: All creatures in the area of effect take 3[[d6]] points of [[bludgeoning damage]] and 2d6 points of [[cold damage]]. ''Ice storm'' will do an additional 1d6 cold damage per additional 3 caster levels.

name: Identify
description: Over the next two rounds, the caster gains a bonus of 10 +1 per [[caster level]] to their [[lore]] skill.

name: Implosion
description: The caster creates a vortex of destruction that tears asunder all living things within its [[area of effect]], killing them instantly unless they make their [[saving throw]].

name: Improved invisibility
description: The target [[creature]] becomes [[invisible]] and impossible to detect using normal vision. After attacking or casting spells the target creature will become partially visible and detectable by enemies, but still retain a 50% [[concealment|cover bonus]].

name: Incendiary cloud
description: The caster creates a cloud of smoke and embers that causes 4[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]] each round to all creatures within the [[area of effect]].

name: Inferno
description: The caster causes a target to ignite into flame. Each round the target will suffer 2[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]].

name: Infestation of maggots
description: With but a touch, you infect a target with maggot-like creatures. They deal 1[[d4]] points of temporary [[constitution]] damage each round. Each round the subject makes a new fortitude save. The spell ends if the target succeeds at its [[saving throw]].

name: Inflict critical wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a [[touch attack]], the target suffers 4[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], + 1 point per caster level to a maximum of +20. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict light wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a [[touch attack]], the target suffers 1[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], + 1 point per caster level to a maximum of +5. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict minor wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a [[touch attack]], the target suffers 1 point of [[negative energy damage|damage]]. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict moderate wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a [[touch attack]], the target suffers 2[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], + 1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +10). Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict serious wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a [[touch attack]], the target suffers 3[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]], + 1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +15). Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on [[undead]], causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Invisibility purge
description: This spell removes the [[invisibility]] from all invisible creatures and items.

name: Invisibility (spell)
description: The target creature becomes [[invisible]] and impossible to detect using normal vision. Any attack or spellcasting action taken by the invisible creature will immediately cancel the invisibility.

name: Invisibility sphere
description: The caster brings into being a zone of [[invisibility]] that travels with him for the duration of the spell. All allies within the spell's [[area of effect]] are rendered invisible, but not to each other. Those that leave the sphere are visible once more.

name: Ironguts
description: When touched, the target creature gains a +4 circumstance bonus on [[fortitude]] saves against all [[poison]]s.

name: Isaac's greater missile storm
description: A number of energy missiles (one per [[caster level]] but to a maximum of 20) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile [[creature]] in the [[area of effect]]. If there are more creatures than missiles, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more missiles than creatures, one of the creatures will be hit with multiple missiles. Each missile does 2[[d6]] points of [[magical damage]].

name: Isaac's lesser missile storm
description: A number of energy missiles (one per caster level but to a maximum of 10) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile creature in the area of effect. If there are more creatures than missiles, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more missiles than creatures, one of the creatures will be hit with multiple missiles. Each missile does 1[[d6]] points of [[magical damage|damage]].

name: Keen edge
description: Adds the [[keen]] property to the targeted [[slashing damage|slashing]] melee weapon, increasing its critical [[threat range]].

name: Knock
area: colossal (''50'' [[meter]] radius) <!-- Not the standard colossal -->
description: This spell will unlock [[door]]s and [[container]]s sealed by conventional locks in a 150ft radius around the caster. Exceptionally complex locking mechanisms or magically sealed doors and containers are beyond the abilities of this spell.

name: Legend lore
description: This spell grants the caster a +10 bonus to [[lore]] checks, +1 per 2 [[caster level]]s.

name: Lesser dispel
description: This spell attempts to strip all [[magical effect]]s from a single [[target]]. It can also target a group of [[creature]]s, attempting to remove the most powerful [[spell]] effect from each creature. To remove an effect from a creature the caster makes a [[dispel]] check of 1d20, +1 per [[caster level]] (to a maximum of +5) against a [[difficulty class|DC]] of 11 + the spell effect's caster level.

name: Lesser mind blank
description: This spell renders the target creature immune to [[mind-affecting]] spells and spell-like effects, and removes all negative effects caused by such spells.

name: Lesser planar binding
description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single [[outsider]], or [[summon]]ing a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are [[paralysis|paralyzed]] for 1 round per 2 caster levels. The type of summoned ally is based on the caster's [[alignment]]:

name: Lesser restoration
description: Removes all [[magical effect|magical]], [[extraordinary effect|extraordinary]], and [[supernatural effect]]s that apply a penalty to [[ability]] scores, [[armor class]], [[attack bonus|attack]] and damage rolls, [[spell resistance]], and [[saving throw]]s. This spell will not remove the effects of a [[curse]] or a [[disease]].

name: Lesser spell breach
description: This spell strips an enemy mage of up to two magical defenses, including [[lesser spell mantle]], [[spell mantle]], [[greater spell mantle]], [[minor globe of invulnerability]], [[globe of invulnerability]], [[stoneskin]], [[greater stoneskin]], [[premonition]], [[protection from elements]], [[ghostly visage]], [[ethereal visage]], [[mage armor]], [[shadow shield]] and [[elemental shield]]. This spell will also reduce the target creature's [[spell resistance|SR]] by 3 for ten [[round]]s.

name: Lesser spell mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that [[spell level absorption|absorbs]] all incoming spells and spell-like abilities. It can absorb up to 1[[d4]]+6 levels of spells before collapsing.

name: Light
description: Creates a small light source above the target creature's head. The light travels with the target and is capable of illuminating a small area. It can be cast on any item the character can equip to make it glow for the spell's duration like a natural source of light.

name: Lightning bolt
area: chain of targets in a straight line
description:
The caster fires a bolt of lightning that passes through all
creatures in a straight line from the caster. The bolt does 1[[d6]] points of [[electrical damage]] per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6.

name: Mage armor
description: The selected target gains the following bonuses to his [[armor class|AC]]: +1 [[natural armor bonus|natural armor]], +1 [[dodge bonus|dodge]], +1 [[deflection bonus|deflection]], and +1 [[armor bonus|enhancement]]. The dodge bonus [[stack]]s with other dodge bonuses to AC, but the other bonuses do not stack with bonuses of the same type.

name: Magic circle against alignment
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses to be protected from either [[good]] or [[evil]]. The spell target and all allies within 10 feet receive a +2 [[deflection bonus]] to [[armor class]], +2 to all [[saving throw]]s, and immunity to any [[mind-affecting]] spells and spell-like abilities used by creatures of the chosen [[alignment]].

name: Magic fang
description: This spell strengthens the caster's [[animal companion]], giving it +1 [[attack bonus|to hit]] and +1 to damage. It also grants the creature the ability to strike as if it were a +1 weapon (so it can bypass other creatures' [[damage reduction]]).

name: Magic missile
description: The caster creates a shimmering projectile of magical force that unerringly slams into a single selected target. After level 1, the spell creates 1 additional missile every two [[caster level]]s, to a maximum of 5 missiles at level 9. Magic missiles do 1[[d4]]+1 points of [[magical damage|damage]] each.

name: Magic vestment
description: You empower the touched armor or shield with a +1 [[armor class|AC]] bonus per 3 caster levels (maximum of +5).

name: Magic weapon
description: You empower the touched weapon with a +1 [[enhancement bonus]].

name: Mass blindness/deafness
description: All enemies within a 10-ft radius are struck [[blind]] and [[deaf]].

name: Mass camouflage
description: All allies in the [[area of effect]] gain a +10 bonus to their [[hide]] skill.

name: Mass charm
description: In the eyes of all non-allied creatures within the [[area of effect]], the personal [[reputation]] of the caster is improved by 50%. The caster can charm up to twice his <s>hit dice</s>[[caster level]] in creatures.

name: Mass haste
description: All allies within the [[area of effect]] gain 1 extra action per round (allowing an additional attack or spell casting) and have their [[movement speed]] increased by 50%.

name: Mass heal
description: All allies within the area of effect are restored to full [[hit point]]s. Healing spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], harming instead of healing them (undead are reduced to 1[[d4]] hit points with this spell).

name: Melf's acid arrow
description: The caster targets a single creature with an acid bolt. The initial [[acid damage|damage]] from the spell is 3[[d6]], +1d6 every round until the spell expires.

name: Mestil's acid breath
description: You breathe forth a cone of acidic droplets. The cone inflicts 1[[d6]] points of [[acid damage]] per caster level (maximum 10d6).

name: Mestil's acid sheath
description: This spell creates an acid shield around your person. Any creature striking you with its body does normal damage, but at the same time the attacker takes 1[[d6]] points +2 points per caster level of [[acid damage]].

name: Meteor swarm
description: The spell causes everything within the area of effect to be pummeled by incoming meteors. All those caught in the destruction take 20[[d6]] points of [[fire damage|[fire] damage]]. All creatures within 5 6.6 feet of the caster are protected from the spell's effect.

name: Mind blank
description: This spell renders all allies within the area of effect immune to [[mind-affecting]] [[spell]]s and [[effect]]s. All negative mind-affecting effects are also removed from the target creatures.

name: Mind fog
description: This spell creates a bank of blue fog that saps the will of all those who enter it. Victims take a -10 penalty on will [[saving throw]]s against [[mind-affecting]] spells and effects. This penalty persists for as long as the creature remains in the fog and for an additional 2[[d6]] rounds upon leaving.

name: Minor globe of invulnerability
description: A shimmering field of energy prevents all spells of level 3 or lower from affecting the caster.

name: Monstrous regeneration
description: For the duration of the spell, the [[target]] [[creature]] gains the ability to [[regenerate]] 3 [[hit point]]s every round.

name: Mordenkainen's disjunction
description:
''Mordenkainen's disjunction'' attempts to strip all [[magical effect]]s from a single target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the two most powerful spell effects from each creature. To remove an effect, the caster makes a [[dispel]] check of 1[[d20]], +1 per [[caster level]] (to a maximum of +40) against a [[difficulty class|DC]] of 11 + the spell effect's caster level. In addition to its ability to dispel effects, this spell also [[breach|strip]]s a single enemy of up to 6 magical defenses or a group of enemies of two spell protections each. Finally, the spell will lower the [[spell resistance|SR]] of all creatures within the area of effect by 10.

Affected spells include: [[spell mantle]]s, [[globe of invulnerability|globes of invulnerability]], [[stoneskin]]s, [[premonition]], [[protection from elements]], [[ghostly visage|ghostly]] and [[ethereal visage]], [[mage armor]], [[shadow shield]] and [[elemental shield]].

name: Mordenkainen's sword
description: The caster summons a powerful, sword-wielding [[helmed horror (summon)|helmed horror]] that acts as a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Mummy dust
description: The caster summons a powerful [[warrior lord|mummy warrior]] to the targeted location to fight on his side.

name: Nature's balance
description: All enemies within the [[area of effect]] have their [[spell resistance]] lowered by 1[[d4]] for every 5 caster levels. All allies within the area of effect are healed for 3d8 [[hit point]]s, +1 point per caster level.

name: Negative energy burst
description: All [[creature]]s caught in the [[area of effect]] take 1[[d8]] points of [[negative energy damage]], +1 per [[caster level]], to a maximum of +20. All creatures caught in the area also [[ability score loss|lose]] 1 point of [[strength]] per 4 caster levels. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], healing instead of harming them.

name: Negative energy protection
description: The target creature is rendered immune to all [[negative energy damage|negative energy]] attacks, including supernatural [[ability damage]] and [[level drain]]s.

name: Negative energy ray
description: A ray of negative energy slams into the target creature, doing 1[[d6]] points of [[negative energy damage|damage]]. After level 1, the spell does an additional 1d6 points of damage for every 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d6 at level 9. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on [[undead]], healing instead of harming them.

name: Neutralize poison
description: A target [[creature]] has all traces of [[poison]] removed from their system.

name: One with the land
description: The caster forges a strong link with nature, gaining a +4 competence bonus to [[animal empathy]], [[hide]], [[move silently]], and [[set trap]] skills.

name: Owl's insight
description: The target gains an enhancement bonus to [[wisdom]] equal to half the caster's level.

name: Owl's wisdom
description: The target creature's [[wisdom]] is increased by 1[[d4]]+1.

name: Phantasmal killer
description: The caster conjures an image of utmost horror to strike down a single creature. The target may attempt a will [[saving throw|save]] to disbelieve the spell, avoiding all ill effects. Failing that, the target then makes a fortitude save to avoid instant death. A successful save still inflicts 3[[d6]] points of [[magical damage]].

name: Planar ally
description: An [[outsider]] is [[summon]]ed to assist the caster. The type of outsider varies with the caster's [[alignment]].

name: Planar binding
description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single [[outsider]], or [[summon]]ing a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are [[paralyze]]d for 1 [[round]] per 2 caster levels. The type of summoned ally is based on the caster's [[alignment]]:

name: Poison (spell)
description: <s>If the caster succeeds at a melee [[touch attack]],</s> the target must make a fortitude [[saving throw|save]] or suffer the effects of [[large scorpion venom]] (1[[d6]] [[strength]] damage on primary and secondary hits).

name: Polymorph self
description: The caster is able to [[polymorph|turn himself into]] one of the following forms: giant spider, troll, umber hulk, pixie, zombie.

name: Power word, kill
description: This spell may be cast on a single creature or as an area effect. A targeted creature of up to 100 [[hit point]]s is killed instantly. As an area effect, this spell will kill all creatures with fewer than 20 hit points, to a maximum total of 200 hit points.

name: Power word, stun
description: Automatically [[stunned|stun]]s a single target for a duration based on the target's [[hit point]]s:

name: Prayer
description: All allies within the [[area of effect]] gain +1 to [[attack bonus|attack]] and damage rolls, [[skill check]]s, and [[saving throw]]s. Enemies receive -1 penalties to the same.

name: Premonition
description: ''Premonition'' allows the caster to see a few moments into the future. This grants him [[damage reduction]] 30/+5, and absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level before collapsing.

name: Prismatic spray
description:
All [[creature]]s within the [[area of effect]] randomly experience 1 or 2 of the following [[effect]]s:
* 20 [[fire damage]] ([[reflex]])
* 40 [[acid damage]] (reflex)
* 80 [[electrical damage]] (reflex)
* Struck with [[bebilith venom]] poison ([[fortitude]])
* [[Paralyze]]d for 10 [[round]]s (fortitude)
* [[Confused]] for 10 rounds ([[will]] vs. mind-affecting)
* Struck dead (will vs. death magic)

name: Protection from alignment
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses a target to be protected from either [[good]] or [[evil]]. The target receives a +2 [[deflection bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]], +2 to all [[saving throw]]s, and immunity to any [[mind-affecting]] spells and spell-like abilities used by creatures of the chosen [[alignment]].

name: Protection from elements
description: The target creature gains [[damage resistance]] 30/- against all elemental forms of damage. The spell ends after absorbing 40 points of damage from any single elemental [[damage type|type]].

name: Protection from spells
description: Within the [[area of effect]], up to one ally per 4 caster levels receives a +8 bonus on all [[saving throw]]s against [[spell]]s.

name: Quillfire
description: The caster throws poisonous quills at a target, doing 1[[d8]] points of [[magical damage|damage]] (+1 per 2 levels of the caster — max +5), plus inflicting [[large scorpion venom|scorpion venom]] on the target if they fail a fortitude [[saving throw|save]].

name: Raise dead
description: Returns one target corpse to life. The raised character returns to life with only 1 [[hit point]].

name: Ray of enfeeblement
description: The target creature takes 1[[d6]] [[strength]] [[ability score loss|damage]], plus 1 per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 11 damage.

name: Ray of frost
description: Does 1[[d4]] + 1 [[cold damage]] to a single target creature.

name: Regenerate (spell)
description: For the duration of the spell, the target creature gains the ability to [[regenerate]] 6 [[hit point]]s every round.

name: Remove blindness/deafness
description: All allies within the area of effect are cured of [[blind]]ness and [[deaf]]ness.

name: Remove curse
description: All [[curse]]s and curse [[effect]]s are removed from the target creature.

name: Remove disease
description: All [[disease]]s and disease [[effect]]s are removed from the target creature.

name: Remove fear
description: All [[fear]] effects are removed from allies within the area of effect. The targets also gain a +4 bonus to [[saving throw]]s against fear [[spell]]s and [[effect]]s for the duration of the spell.

name: Remove paralysis
description: All [[paralysis]] and hold effects are removed from allies within the [[area of effect]].

name: Resist elements
description: The target creature gains [[damage resistance]] 20/- against all elemental [[damage type|forms of damage]]. The spell ends after absorbing 30 points of accumulated damage from any single elemental type.

name: Resistance
description: Grants the target creature a +1 bonus to all [[saving throw]]s.

name: Restoration
description: Removes all [[magical effect|magical]], [[extraordinary effect|extraordinary]] and [[supernatural effect]]s that apply a penalty to [[ability]] scores, [[armor class]], [[attack bonus|attack]] and damage rolls, [[spell resistance]], [[saving throw]]s and damage [[immunity]]. This spell also removes all [[ability drain]], [[level drain]], [[blind|blindness]] and [[deaf|deafness]] effects. While this spell will not remove a [[curse]] or [[disease]] itself, it will remove ([[supernatural effect|supernatural]]) ability score penalties caused by a disease.

name: Restoration (others)
description: Removes all [[magical effect|magical]], [[extraordinary effect|extraordinary]] and [[supernatural effect]]s that apply a penalty to [[ability]] scores, [[armor class]], [[attack bonus|attack]] and damage rolls, [[spell resistance]], [[saving throw]]s and damage [[immunity]]. This spell also removes all [[ability drain]], [[level drain]], [[blind]]ness and [[deaf]]ness effects. This spell will not remove the effects of a [[curse]] or a [[disease]].

name: Resurrection
description: Returns a single target corpse to life with full [[hit point]]s.

name: Rogue's cunning
description: Provides a temporary +5 bonus to [[open lock]]s and +10 bonus to [[search]], [[disable trap]], [[move silently]], [[pick pocket]]s, [[set trap]], and [[hide]].

name: Sanctuary
description: The caster's or the person's, touched by the caster, presence is completely ignored by nearby creatures for the duration of the spell.

name: Scare
description:
A target creature with 5 [[hit dice]] or less is afflicted with
[[frightened|fear]] and suffers a -2 morale check to [[attack bonus|attack]], damage and [[saving throw|saving]] rolls.

name: Scintillating sphere
description: The caster unleashes a crackling electric projectile that explodes upon all within the area of effect for 1[[d6]] points of [[electrical damage]] per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6.

name: Searing light
description:
The caster directs a beam of white-hot light at a single target. The [[divine damage|damage]] is based on the target's [[race|racial type]]:
* [[Undead]]: 1[[d8]] per caster level, to a maximum of 10d8
* [[Construct]]: 1[[d6]] for every 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d6
* Other: 1d8 for per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d8

name: See invisibility
description: The target creature is able to see all [[invisible]] creatures within his line of sight.

name: Shades
description: The caster conjures a shadow variant of one of the following spells: [[cone of cold]], [[fireball]], [[stoneskin]], [[wall of fire]], or [[summon shadow (shadow conjuration)|summon shadow]].

name: Shadow conjuration
description: The caster conjures a shadow variant of one of the following spells: [[darkness (spell)|darkness]], [[invisibility (spell)|invisibility]], [[mage armor]], [[magic missile]], or [[summon shadow (shadow conjuration)|summon shadow]].

name: Shadow shield
description:
The caster is shrouded in a cloak of shadow that protects them with the following effects:
* +5 [[natural armor bonus|natural AC bonus]]
* 10/+3 [[damage reduction]]
* immunity to [[death magic|instant death effects]]
* immunity to [[necromancy]] spells
* immunity to [[negative energy damage]]

name: Shapechange
description: The caster is temporarily [[polymorph|transform]]ed into one of several fearsome creatures of destruction. Possible forms include: [[red dragon form|red dragon]], [[fire giant form|fire giant]], [[balor form|balor]], [[death slaad form (shapechange)|death slaad]], or [[iron golem form (shapechange)|iron golem]].

name: Shelgarn's persistent blade
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[Shelgarn's persistent blade (summon)|dagger]] that acts as a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Shield of faith
description: The target gains a +2 [[deflection bonus]] to their [[armor class]], with an additional +1 bonus for every six levels of the caster (maximum of +5).

name: Shield (spell)
description: The caster gains a +4 [[deflection bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]]. The caster is also immune to the spell [[magic missile]] for the duration of the ''shield''.

name: Silence (spell)
description: Creates a zone of [[silence]] around the target creature, preventing all within the [[area of effect]] from casting spells with V (verbal) [[component]]s. If cast on an ally, no [[saving throw]]s or spell resistance checks are necessary.

name: Slay living
description: The target must make a fortitude save or die. Even if the [[saving throw]] is successful, the target takes 3[[d6]] points of [[negative energy damage]], +1 point per caster level.

name: Sleep (spell)
description: Causes 4 + 1[[d4]] [[hit dice|HD]] of creatures to fall into a comatose [[sleep|slumber]], beginning with those with the fewest HD. Creatures with 5 or more HD are unaffected.

name: Slow (spell)
description: All enemy creatures within the [[area of effect]] are [[slow]]ed, having their [[movement rate|movement]] lowered by 50% and lose a single attack per round.

name: Sound burst
description: All creatures within the [[area of effect]] take 1[[d8]] points of [[sonic damage|damage]] and must make a will save or be [[stunned]] for 2 [[round]]s.

name: Spell mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that [[spell level absorption|absorbs]] all incoming [[spell]]s and spell-like abilities. It can absorb up to 1[[d8]]+8 spell levels before collapsing.

name: Spell resistance (spell)
description: The target creature has its [[spell resistance]] set to 12, +1 per caster level. If the target already had a higher spell resistance, this spell has no effect.

name: Spike growth
description: Covers the terrain with small spikes. Any creature will suffer 1[[d4]] points of [[piercing damage|damage]] each round that they remain within the afflicted area. These spikes can damage the victim's legs, so that even once they are free of the spike growth, their [[movement rate]] is slowed for a [[day]].

name: Stinking cloud
description: All creatures caught within the [[area of effect]] are [[dazed]]. These effects last as long as they remain within the cloud and for 1 round after they leave.

name: Stone bones
description: You cause the target undead to gain a +3 [[natural armor bonus|natural]] [[armor class]] bonus, due to the thickening of its bones.

name: Stone to flesh
description: This spell restores a [[petrified]] creature to its normal state, restoring life and goods.

name: Stonehold
description: Creates a cloud that [[paralyze]]s any creatures inside of it, encasing them in stone for 1[[d6]] rounds.

name: Stoneskin
description: This spell grants the target creature [[damage reduction]] 10/+5. The spell absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level, to a maximum of 100, before collapsing.

name: Storm of vengeance
description: The area around the caster is blasted by lightning and acidic rain. Each round, all enemies within the area of effect take 3[[d6]] points of [[acid damage]]. Those who fail a reflex [[saving throw|save]] take an additional <del>3d6</del> ''6d6'' points of [[electrical damage]] and are [[stunned]] for <del>one</del> ''two'' round''s''.

name: Summon creature I
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire badger]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature II
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire boar]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature III
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire wolf (summon)|dire wolf]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature IV
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire spider (summon)|dire spider]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature IX
description: The caster [[summon]]s a random elder [[elemental]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature V
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire bear]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature VI
description: The caster [[summon]]s a [[dire tiger]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature VII
description: The caster summons a random huge [[huge air elemental|air]], [[huge fire elemental|fire]] or [[huge water elemental|water]] elemental to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon creature VIII
description: The caster [[summon]]s a random greater [[elemental]] to be a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Summon shadow (shadow conjuration)
description: This spell opens a portal to the [[Plane of Shadows]] and draws forth a shadow ally to become a faithful and loyal servant. Illusionists are able to use this spell in conjunction with the [[shades]], [[shadow conjuration]], and [[greater shadow conjuration]] spells. The shadow ally summoned depends on caster level:

name: Sunbeam
description: The caster summons a globe of divine radiance to blind and burn those within the area of effect. [[Undead]] take 1[[d6]] points of [[divine damage]] per caster level, to a maximum of 20d6. All other monster types take 3d6 points of divine damage, and are [[blind]]ed for 3 rounds. A successful reflex [[saving throw|save]] halves the damage for undead and voids blindness for others.

name: Sunburst
description: A brilliant explosion occurs where the caster directs causing 1[[d6]] points of [[magical damage]] per caster level (to a maximum of 25d6) to all [[undead]]. Non-undead creatures suffer only 6d6 damage. [[Vampire]]s are destroyed instantly if they fail a reflex [[saving throw]]. All enemies in the area of effect must also make a successful reflex saving throw or be [[blind]]ed permanently (the blindness can only be magically removed).

name: Tasha's hideous laughter
description: If the target fails their [[saving throw]] they will begin laughing hysterically. They will be unable to defend themselves until the spell wears off. A creature whose [[race|racial type]] is different from the caster's gains a +4 bonus on its saving throw because humor doesn't 'translate' well.

name: Tenser's transformation
description: The caster becomes an [[doom knight form|engine of destruction]], gaining a +1 [[attack bonus]] for every 2 caster levels, a +4 natural armor [[armor class|AC]] bonus, 20 [[strength]], 22 [[dexterity]], 18 [[constitution]], +5 to their [[fortitude]] [[saving throw]]s, and +1[[d6]] additional [[temporary hit point|hit point]]s per caster level.

name: Tide of battle
description: Centered around the caster, this spell rains down [[divine damage|holy damage]] on all within the [[area of effect]], including the caster. Each target will take between 30 and 100 damage.

name: Time stop
description: The caster is able to defy the sands of time, casting spells, moving about, and attacking normally while the rest of the world appears suspended, as if in stasis.

name: True seeing (spell)
description: The target creature can see through [[sanctuary]] and [[invisibility]] effects, and automatically [[spot]]s [[hide|hiding]] opponents.

name: True strike
description: Through magical intuition the caster gains a +20 bonus to [[attack roll]]s.

name: Ultravision
description: The target creature's ability to see in complete darkness is improved beyond that of [[darkvision]]. When this spell is applied even the effects of magical [[darkness]] are pierced.

name: Undeath to death
description: This spell slays 1[[d4]] [[hit dice|HD]] worth of [[undead]] creatures per [[caster level]] (maximum 20d4). Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first; among creatures with equal HD, those closest to the point of origin of the burst are affected first.

name: Undeath's eternal foe
description: All allies in the area of effect will receive the following bonuses: immunity to [[negative energy damage]], immunity to [[level drain|level/energy drain]], immunity to [[ability score loss|ability score decreases]], immunity to [[poison]]s, immunity to [[disease]]s and a +4 [[deflection bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]].

name: Vampiric touch
description: The target creature takes 1[[d6]] points of [[negative energy damage]] for every 2 caster levels (maximum 10d6). This damage is then applied to the caster's hit points as a [[temporary hit point|temporary bonus]]. You can't gain more temporary hit points than what is required to kill the target (target's current hit points +10).

name: Vine mine
description:
When casting ''vine mine'', the caster must select one of the following effects that will be created in the targeted area:
* [[entangle]] (as [[entangle (spell)|the spell]])
* hamper movement (movement speed is halved)
* camouflage (add +4 competence bonus on [[hide]] checks)

name: Virtue
description: The target creature gains 1 [[temporary hit point]] above his maximum total.

name: Wail of the banshee
description: All enemies within the area of effect must succeed at a fortitude [[saving throw|save]] or die, to a maximum of 1 enemy per caster level.

name: Wall of fire
description: This spell creates a curtain of fire that deals 4[[d6]] points of [[fire damage]] to any creature that attempts to pass through it.

name: War cry
description: The caster lets out a powerful shout that grants the bard a +2 bonus to [[attack bonus|attack]] and damage. All enemies within the [[area of effect]] are stricken with [[fear]].

name: Web
description: Sticky strands cling to all creatures within the [[area of effect]], [[entangle|entangling]] them. Creatures who make their save can move, but at a [[movement speed decrease|reduced rate]] depending on their [[strength]].

name: Weird
description: A horrible phantasm rises to stand before enemy creatures in the area of effect, causing them to make a will [[saving throw|save]]. If they fail, the phantasm touches them and they must now make a fortitude saving throw. If this saving throw fails, the creature dies. Those who succeed the fortitude save still take 3[[d6]] points of [[magical damage]]. Creatures with less than 4 [[hit dice]] automatically die, without any saving throws.

name: Word of faith
description: A wave of divine energy blasts all enemy creatures within the [[area of effect]]. All enemies within the area are [[stunned]] for 1 [[round]] per 2 [[caster level]]s. Those with 4 [[hit dice]] or less are killed instantly. Any hostile [[summon]]ed creatures are returned to their home planes.

name: Wounding whispers
description: The caster is surrounded with whispers that injure any creature that hits the caster for 1[[d6]]+1/level points of [[sonic damage]].
